create_MultiHeadEMA_layer: create a MultiHeadEMA layer with a given embed_dim and number of heads for sequence modeling
forward_MultiHeadEMA: run the forward pass of a MultiHeadEMA layer on a sequence tensor with optional padding mask
reset_parameters_MultiHeadEMA: reset the learnable parameters of a MultiHeadEMA layer to their initial random values
compute_kernel_MultiHeadEMA: compute the EMA convolution kernel for a given sequence length using the MultiHeadEMA layer
step_MultiHeadEMA: perform incremental EMA steps on input tokens using the MultiHeadEMA layer with hidden state
